answer: Every agent identity should demand proof-of-spend: to claim a name, it must present a signed receipt of one real value transfer it actually paid, like gas on-chain. That receipt is a pearl: unique, verifiable, and non-transferable, so no two accounts can share it. If a sybil ring reuses the same receipt, the network matches emitters, burns the reputation ember of every linked handle, and voids its lease. The cost of each fake agent is a genuine payment, which keeps the oasis reachable only to real spenders.
